_comment: Three entries, so `a1.js` and `a2.js` are in one common chunk, and `w.js` is in another common chunk. `main.js` defers `a1.js` and `a2.js`, and `b.js` imports `a1.js`, `w.js`, then `a2.js`. `import './w.js'` keeps no statement, but the chunk of `b.js` still imports the chunk of `w.js`, so the init of `a2.js` must come after that import. The output runs `a1`, `w`, then `a2`, as native ESM does.
